## Description {#details}

The <code><Link to="/docs/api/structs/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/type-traits/genuine-integral-value">genuine&#95;integral&#95;value</Link></code> struct template encapsulates a runtime integral value, providing a consistent interface for value access and conversion. It inherits from <code>op</code> to enable unified handling within the µTest++ framework&#39;s type traits and metaprogramming utilities.

This struct template exposes the value via a member variable, a getter method, and an explicit conversion operator. It is intended for use cases where a value must be wrapped and treated generically within the framework, supporting advanced template metaprogramming and type introspection.
